pullRequest.title: Review pane redesign: companion pane, PR/MR scope, merge-conflict viewer
pullRequest.body:
## Summary

Replaces the RHS diff sidebar/drawer system with one continuous virtualized review surface, mounted as a **companion pane** beside its source thread. All five phases of [`docs/architecture/review-pane-design.md`](docs/architecture/review-pane-design.md):

1. **Pane kinds + companion panes** — plan/design-preview/review companions paired to a source pane via `sourcePaneId`, persisted + restored; the RHS sidebar/drawer system is deleted.
2. **Virtual-engine features** — keyed mid-splice reorders with anchor-based scroll compensation; exact-height rows (`RowEstimate.isExact`) that skip ResizeObservers entirely.
3. **Review pane** — turn/session/workspace/branch scopes over one virtualized diff, inline comment layer with SQLite-backed drafts, GitHub-style file tree, sticky file header, `j/k/n/p/c` keyboard nav.
4. **PR/MR scope** via `gh`/`glab` — PR header (verdicts/checks/mergeability), 45s poll pump with snapshot diffing (`pr:updated`), review threads inline in the diff with reply / send-to-agent, structured review submission with partial-failure semantics, drafts keyed `pr:{forge}:{repo}:{number}` so they survive head pushes (migrations v17/v18).
5. **Merge-conflict viewer** — local `git merge-tree` against fetched PR head refs (`pull/N/head` / `merge-requests/N/head`), read-only conflict-marker rendering through the same surface.

### Fixes found while testing live

- **Blank-until-scroll on reopen / split-toggle** — the virtual engine tail-seeds its window until its first scroll input; the top-anchored review surface never fired one. `ReviewDiffBody` now `revalidate()`s after position restore (browser regression test included).
- **VirtualRow observe churn** — the new `observe` prop was read reactively through the windowed `$derived`, re-attaching the whole window's ResizeObservers on every geometry update; now read untracked.
- **Review UX pass** — between-files separation gap painted inside the exact-height header row, file-tree search + extension-chip filters + indent guides + kind tints + resizable rail, `N files +A −D` totals in the toolbar.
- **Companion panes move as one unit** — layout inserts resnap around source+companion blocks, single-step pane moves cross whole blocks, drag-drop targets snap to block edges.

## Test plan

- `make go-build` / `make go-test` ✅
- `cd frontend && pnpm run check` ✅ (0 errors), `pnpm test` ✅ (348 files / 5005 tests), `pnpm run build` ✅
- `pnpm test:browser` ✅ (real-Chromium virtualizer suite, 32 tests)
- Live-verified PR head-ref fetch + review submission against GitHub and GitLab sandboxes (`randalmurphal/ao-review-spike` PR #1, `ranmurph/ao-review-spike` MR !1)
